review.shorterRoute: Use the existing literal diagonal equations and mapGL injectivity, avoiding a second matrix-division calculation. Existing chosen-coset trace comparison is available for the subsequent H1 step. For exact coset surjectivity, reuse full integral SL2 reduction and the existing SL2 Chinese-remainder equivalence; the older raised-level coset proof handles Gamma0 only, so it cannot by itself supply Gamma1 representatives.
review.assumptionsToDischarge: The original Gamma1 diagonal cover preserves the actual upper subgroup and commutes with its literal integral Hecke conjugation. Then derive the good-prime cover coset bijection from actual coprime principal-level lifting; no new general strong approximation theorem is needed. Identify every chosen original Hecke representative and conjugated transition with its actual Gamma1 cover counterpart.
review.remaining: A commuting group square alone does not prove coset bijections or H1 transfer/Hecke compatibility; these and arithmetic Galois realization remain. 16/20; DUB-17--20 OPEN.
